# Bundled font notices

The application and editable brand graphics bundle fonts from these families. Their upstream SIL Open Font License notices are retained alongside this file.

- [newsreader](https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/newsreader) — `newsreader-OFL.txt`
- [librecaslontext](https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/librecaslontext) — `librecaslontext-OFL.txt`
- [fragmentmono](https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/fragmentmono) — `fragmentmono-OFL.txt`
- [instrumentsans](https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/instrumentsans) — `instrumentsans-OFL.txt`
- [courierprime](https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/courierprime) — `courierprime-OFL.txt`

These notices apply to the font software; they do not assign a license to the Launch a Card application or its brand/card artwork.
